versions.changelog:
Initial release: Socratic Business Model Canvas skill  
- Guides users to systematically build a complete Business Model Canvas through progressive, layered Socratic questioning.
- Covers all 9 blocks of the Business Model Canvas with foundation, deep-dive, and essence questions for each.
- Bilingual prompts (English and Chinese) for each module and question.
- Emphasizes understanding user context before diving into the Canvas process.
- Focuses on helping users uncover underlying business logic and validate assumptions.
